# Mountain House

> > Mountain House provides freeze-dried meals and emergency food kits with a 30-year shelf life for camping, backpacking, and disaster preparedness.

Mountain House specializes in freeze-dried food products including customizable emergency kits, multi-day survival provisions, and outdoor meals. The site offers product information, a rewards program, and educational content covering camping, hiking, emergency preparedness, and outdoor adventure planning.

## Key Topics

- freeze-dried food
- emergency preparedness
- 30-year shelf life
- camping meals
- backpacking food
- disaster preparedness
- survival food storage
- gluten-free options
- #10 cans
- 3-day emergency kits
- outdoor adventure
- Mountain House Rewards
- FIFO rotation
- Meals Ready to Eat (MRE)
- customizable food kits

## Emergency Food Kits & Preparedness

- [Multi-Day Emergency Food Kits](https://mountainhouse.com/collections/multi-day-emergency-kits): Emergency food kits with 30-year shelf life for multi-day preparedness
- [Build Your Own 3-Day Freeze-Dried Food Kit](https://mountainhouse.com/products/build-your-own-3-day-kit): Customizable 3-day freeze-dried meal kit with 29 options for emergencies
- [How To Be An Urban Prepper - Emergency Planning in the City](https://mountainhouse.com/blogs/emergency-prep-survival/how-to-be-an-urban-prepper): Urban prepping guide for city emergency planning and food storage
- [Prepping On A Budget](https://mountainhouse.com/blogs/emergency-prep-survival/prepping-on-a-budget): Budget-friendly emergency preparedness and disaster prepping tips
- [Stay Safe in an Earthquake with the Great ShakeOut](https://mountainhouse.com/blogs/emergency-prep-survival/great-shakeout): Earthquake safety tips and Great ShakeOut event information

- [Cajun Style Jambalaya - Pouch](https://mountainhouse.com/products/cajun-style-jambalaya-pouch): Gluten-free Cajun Jambalaya pouch with chicken, sausage, 32g protein
